## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Monitoring/report semantics are unchanged or documented
- [ ] New behavior has tests where practical
- [ ] No secrets, private datasets, or generated credentials are included

## Monitoring impact

Describe any effect on drift thresholds, anomaly logic, uncertainty, health scoring, report schemas, or API behavior.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out assumptions, follow-up work, or areas that deserve extra review.
